title: MoReBench: Evaluating Procedural and Pluralistic Moral Reasoning in Language Models, More Than Outcomes

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model reasoning traces against expert-written rubrics specific to five distinct normative ethics frameworks (Kantian Deontology, Benthamite Act Utilitarianism, Aristotelian Virtue Ethics, Scanlonian Contractualism, and Gauthierian Contractarianism) to measure partiality and performance disparities in applying different moral theories.

Calculating a length-corrected score (normalizing the rubric fulfillment score by the ratio between the average response length and a reference length) to control for the tendency of more verbose models to artificially score higher.
